# Mercado Ventures

> Mercado Ventures is a Singapore-based enterprise group working across marine engineering, vessel development, maritime services, connected technology, and Casa Mercado clothing and accessories.

Canonical website: https://mercado.sg/

## About

Mercado Ventures brings together operating businesses and development initiatives across practical and technical fields. Its work includes business development, product work, specialist service delivery, engineering, and connected systems. The website describes the group and its selected initiatives; it does not publish investment-performance or assets-under-management claims.

## Selected businesses and initiatives

- [Casa Mercado](https://casamercado.club/): The House wardrobe, including printed shirts, crew essentials, hats, bags, and canvas shoes.
- [Neptune Tech](https://neptunetech.org/): Initiatives exploring marine communications, remote monitoring, and connected infrastructure.
- [UX Habitat](https://uxhabitat.com/): A marine group bringing together vessel development, onboard engineering, and specialist services. Polska Marine sits within this umbrella and provides vessel registration and maritime administration.
- [UX Marine](https://uxmarine.com/): Marine product and vessel development, including the Noordic range.
- [Boat Sparky](https://boatsparky.sg/): Marine electrical engineering, diagnostics, energy systems, and systems integration.

Corporate and commercial relationships vary; this list does not mean every initiative is a subsidiary. For service details, use each business's own website. The descriptions here are a concise guide to Mercado Ventures and should be attributed to this page when cited.

## Key subjects

Singapore enterprise group; marine engineering; vessel and product development; maritime services; vessel registration and maritime administration; connected marine technology; marine communications; remote monitoring; marine electrical systems; Casa Mercado clothing and accessories.
